composers_checked.name: Beethoven, Ludwig van
composers_checked.note: Gap check against the Wikipedia list of compositions (after the New Grove and Kinsky–Halm/Hess): added Hess 31, 33, 34 (not on IMSLP) and the piano-quartet version of Op. 16 (on the quintet page). Floor and durations from complete Apple Music cycles (Emerson, DG Beethoven 2020, Beaux Arts, Perlman/Ashkenazy, Grumiaux, Endellion).

composers_checked.name: Corrette, Michel
composers_checked.note: Gap check against IMSLP's list of the 25 Concertos comiques and MusicBrainz's recorded works: added Nos. 10, 19 and 24 from the 25 Concertos comiques page (gap). Six Symphonies de Noëls kept one entry each (all six recorded by La Fantasia).

note: Not added, for the owner: Beethoven's Hess 32 (first version of Op. 18 No. 1; recorded, DG Beethoven 2020) and the tiny quartet fugues Hess 36 and prelude (Borciani) were left out as an early version and exercises; the piano-trio version of Symphony No. 2 (recorded by the Beaux Arts Trio) was left out because its arranger is uncertain (possibly Ries, authorised by Beethoven); the Mödlinger Tänze WoO 17 are orchestral on IMSLP and of doubtful authenticity. Corrette's six Organ Concertos Op. 26 'a sei strumenti' (organ, 3 violins, flute, viola, cello; recorded by La Risonanza, Stradivaria, Slovak Chamber Orchestra) were left out by the census as orchestral; they could qualify if played one to a part. Corrette's concertos comiques are filed by IMSLP as concertos but are four-part works played one to a part in the recordings found. Keys of Concerto comique No. 7 differ: IMSLP says C minor, the Arion and Stradivaria recordings C major (used).
